notes.title: Demo update #2
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Changing key binds will now work without having to relaunch the game.[/p][/*][*][p]When pausing the game, you are now allowed to move around on the map and zoom. I have a slight suspicion this may interfere with some scrollable UI elements, so let me know if you encounter anything.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug was reported that if you're right in the middle of placing a block, and the objective complete dialog appears, that block will be placed "all over" (according to mouse movement) when you close the dialog. I haven't been able to reproduce it, but I've made an attempt to fix it anyway. I can't confirm if it works, so let me know either way.[/p][/*][*][p]Deleting and copying blocks in a selection will now hide the selection box automatically (saving you a click).[/p][/*][*][p]By popular demand, copying a selection of blocks will now display a ghost image of the selection, making it easier to place. You can press ESC or right click to clear the clipboard again. The "Making selections" tip in the Codex has been updated accordingly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update #1 hotfix #1
notes.notes: [p]You know how I said I hoped I didn't introduce any new bugs in yesterday's update? Well.. I did 🤦‍♂️ [/p][p]Apparently I made it impossible to build single blocks.[/p][p][/p][p]That has now been fixed. Once your Steam client updates the demo, everything should - hopefully - be in order again.[/p][p][/p][p]I am very sorry for the inconvenience.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update #1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the Codex where it wouldn't update/display anything.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed another bug in the Codex where entries would be duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Building conveyor belts while panning the map (using WASD) should now work much better. [b]But, as this is a highly important part of the game, please do let me know if I introduced any new bugs.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Setting window mode in options will now have immediate effect and not require a relaunch of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Items with a sell value of 0 had their sell value hidden in the Codex; sell values will now always be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some tweaks to make up for a misunderstanding: Replacing, building on top of or removing a block will always reimburse the build cost of said block (this is not new). However, that reimbursement isn't noticeable unless you keep an eye on the balance while doing it. To eliminate any confusion, I've removed the negative floaty number that appears when replacing or building on top of another block.[/p][/*][*][p]To make the early game more manageable, the starting balance has been increased from 3000 to 5000.[/p][/*][*][p]Income and expenses associated with removing and building blocks, respectively, are now excluded from the income/expense report. That should make actual operational cost/income more transparent. Do let me know if you prefer this to be a toggle on/off in options.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the tutorial text about the Hub a bit to make it clear that not all items have a sell value.[/p][/*][/list]
